entities.name: Query CoaBC protein
observations: 403 aa protein; predicted molecular mass 42.27 kDa and theoretical pI 6.48.
Pfam detects an N-terminal Flavoprotein domain (PF02441.26; residues 5–179) and a C-terminal DFP domain (PF04127.23; residues 185–392).
Shares 48.9–51.4% identity across 96.8–97.8% of its length with reviewed Vibrio and related CoaBC homologs.
Best-supported annotation is bifunctional coenzyme A biosynthesis protein CoaBC, combining phosphopantothenate–cysteine ligase and phosphopantothenoylcysteine decarboxylase activities.
The ligase reaction uses (R)-4'-phosphopantothenate, L-cysteine, and CTP to produce N-(4-phosphopantothenoyl)-L-cysteine, CMP, and diphosphate.
The decarboxylase reaction converts N-(4-phosphopantothenoyl)-L-cysteine to (R)-4'-phosphopantetheine and CO2.
Reviewed homolog annotations report Mg2+ and FMN association; FMN is bound one per subunit in the reference proteins.
Assigned EC activities in reviewed homologs are EC 6.3.2.5 and EC 4.1.1.36; evidence is homology-based for the query sequence.
